LanguageData.MWAH_KissDirector.label: kiss director
LanguageData.MWAH_KissDirector.description: Opens the kiss director panel: fill the left slot with whoever starts the kiss, the right slot with whoever gets kissed - any two pawns on the map, including ones you do not control - then press the heart. Quick send skips the slots and picks both sides on the map in one go.
